title: SQL Injection via unparameterized f-string in get_last_event_id()
description: The /internal/last-event-id/<identifier> endpoint interpolates the URL path parameter 'identifier' directly into a SQLAlchemy text() SQL query using an f-string, bypassing all parameterization. A caller with UserRoles.colin can inject arbitrary SQL into the PostgreSQL query.
evidence: query = db.session.execute(text(f""" select max(colin_event_id) ... where businesses.identifier = '{identifier}' limit 1 """))

title: SQL Injection via stringify_list() with user-supplied identifiers and filing_types
description: The /cooper reset endpoint reads 'identifiers' and 'filing_types' string lists from the user's JSON request body. These values are passed through stringify_list() which wraps items in single quotes but does not escape embedded single-quote characters, allowing boolean and structure-altering Oracle SQL injection.

title: Inadequate SQL sanitization in stringify_list() utility
description: The stringify_list() utility wraps list items in single quotes and removes spaces and ')' characters as an injection guard, but does not escape embedded single-quote characters. This leaves all six Oracle cursor.execute(f-string) call sites across address.py, office.py, corp_party.py, and reset.py vulnerable whenever string-typed data flows through the function.

title: lxml.etree.fromstring() called without explicit safe XMLParser in MrasService
description: The Legal API MrasService parses XML responses from the MRAS external API using lxml.etree.fromstring() without constructing an explicit XMLParser(resolve_entities=False, no_network=True). While lxml defaults disable external-network entity fetching, the absence of an explicit safe parser leaves the application exposed to local file-system entity inclusion or billion-laughs DoS if the MRAS endpoint returns adversarial XML.
evidence: xml_content = etree.fromstring(response.content)  # no safe parser configured

title: lxml.etree.fromstring() without safe parser in Furnishings MrasService (copy of Legal API)
description: The GCP Furnishings job contains a copy of the Legal API MrasService (acknowledged in its docstring) with the same lxml.etree.fromstring() call without an explicit safe XMLParser. The severity is lower than VULN-004 because this is a scheduled batch job with no external-user attack surface.

title: xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring() used without safe-parser for CRA BN Hub XML responses
description: Multiple Business BN processor modules parse XML responses from the CRA BN Hub using Python's xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring() without explicit safe-parser configuration. Python's stdlib ET is inherently protected against network-based XXE, but does not defend against all entity-expansion denial-of-service attacks. Use of defusedxml would provide defence-in-depth.

title: Missing HTTP Security Response Headers — Legal API
description: The after_request hooks in __init__.py and endpoints.py add only internal version headers (API, SCHEMAS). No Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy headers are set on any response. No Flask-Talisman or equivalent middleware is registered.

title: Missing HTTP Security Response Headers — COLIN API
description: The sole after_request hook in the COLIN API application factory adds only the API version header. No security headers of any kind are applied to responses. The COLIN API processes requests carrying JWT tokens and Oracle CPRD data, making the absence of headers such as HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options a tangible risk.

title: SSH Host Key Validation Unconditionally Bypassed via AutoAddPolicy — GCP Furnishings SFTP
issueCategory: Security Issues Stemming From Trust Managers
description: The SftpConnection.__enter__ method calls ssh_connection.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy()) unconditionally. AutoAddPolicy automatically accepts and stores any SSH host key on first connection without any verification. This policy is active in every production execution connecting to BCLaws and BCMail+ SFTP servers, enabling silent man-in-the-middle interception of all file transfers.

title: SFTP Host Key Verification Conditionally Disabled via Environment Variable — ETL SFTP Jobs
issueCategory: Security Issues Stemming From Trust Managers
description: All three SFTP batch services (sftp-gazette, sftp-icbc-report, sftp-nuans-report) set cnopts.hostkeys = None — completely disabling SSH host key verification — when the environment variable SFTP_VERIFY_HOST equals the string 'false'. An inline comment states 'only for local development' but there is no runtime enforcement preventing this flag from being set in a production deployment.

title: PostgreSQL Connections Without SSL Enforcement — Data Tool
issueCategory: Security Issues Stemming From Encryption Configurations
description: Three database URIs (SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI, SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI_COLIN_MIGR, SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI_AUTH) are always constructed using plain postgresql:// scheme without ?sslmode=require. Unlike the GCP components that use Cloud SQL connector for encrypted connections, the data-tool Prefect flows connect via direct TCP with no SSL enforcement configured at the application level.

title: Oracle CPRD Database Connection Without SSL — COLIN API
issueCategory: Security Issues Stemming From Encryption Configurations
description: The cx_Oracle.SessionPool connecting to the Oracle CPRD legacy database is created without any SSL, wallet, or ssl_context parameters. No Oracle Net encryption level is configured at the application layer; transport security depends entirely on the Oracle listener-side configuration which is outside the application codebase.

title: CORS Wildcard Origin Configured — Legal API
issueCategory: Security Issues Stemming From Integration Configurations
description: Three distinct code paths in the Legal API emit Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * — the JWT auth error handler in __init__.py, the redirect/OPTIONS handler in endpoints.py, and the cors_preflight CORS decorator in utils/util.py. Any origin can make cross-origin requests and read responses, widening the attack surface for cross-origin information leakage.

title: CORS Wildcard Origin Configured — COLIN API
issueCategory: Security Issues Stemming From Integration Configurations
description: The cors_preflight decorator applied to all COLIN API resource classes returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * in every OPTIONS preflight response. Although COLIN API is an internal service, this broadens the cross-origin risk surface to any browser context with network access to the service.
